issue: Scheduled exports stopped after changing workspace timezone.
resolution: Verify the workspace timezone under Settings. After changing the timezone, review the export schedule and save it again to apply the new schedule.

issue: User could not create API credentials.
resolution: Only Owners and Admins can create or revoke API credentials. Viewers and Analysts cannot create API credentials.
Refund requests are outside the OrbitDesk knowledge base and should be directed to the billing or support team.
Security-related issues should be escalated to the support team immediately.
